name: Donut Remix v1.0.0
body:
**Donut Remix v1.0.0 Initial Release**
- Unified RetroTINK 4K Pro and Scalable Video Switch (SVS) firmware.
- Responsive SVS web dashboard with custom input channel naming saved to LittleFS.
- Device-aware mDNS hostname resolution (donutremix-svs.local & donutremix-rt4k.local).
- Authentic WebCtl remote suite and GameID profile automation.
- Built-in session security, rate limiting, and SSRF guardrails.
